test_title: PYST 2: SSC CGL Tier - II (English) (Held on: 3 Feb 2022)
subject: english
question:
Select the correct active form of the given sentence.

Four people were arrested by the police for cheating.

options.text: The police arrested four people for cheating.
The police has arrested four people for cheating.
The police is arresting four people for cheating.
Four people arrested the police for cheating.

solution:
The correct answer is **'The police arrested four people for cheating.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is already in **passive voice **and it's in pas indefinite tense [due to the usage of was/were + verb 3rd form - **'were arrested'**]
 
• In order to convert this sentence into **an active voice**, need to make some **changes in the three following parts.**
 
 
• **Subject **= The police
 
• **Verb **= were arrested [into just verb 2nd form *i.e. arrested]*
 
• **Object **= Four people for cheating.
 
 
 
• **Rule = Subject + verb 2nd form + object.**
 
 
• The sentence would be - ***The police arrested four people for cheating.***
 
 

Hence, the correct answer is **option 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**Let's **understand **the **concept **with some **more examples.**

 
• The sweets were distributed by the students.
 
 
• *The students distributed the sweets.*
 
 
 
• The thief was caught by the police.
 
 
• *The police caught the thief.*
